title: I just released the first playable alpha of Wreck Riot, my Twisted Metal-inspired car combat game!
author: Candid-Cauliflower-4
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on **Wreck Riot**, a 3D arcade vehicular combat game built in Godot with AI assistance, and the first public alpha is finally live!

You can drive weaponized cars, fire missiles, fight AI opponents, and smash through destructible environments.

The game currently features three vehicles — Inferno, Viper, and Razorback — with more content planned.

**🎮 Play free in your browser (Chrome/Edge):**

[https://dsrando2.itch.io/wreck-riot](https://dsrando2.itch.io/wreck-riot)

I'd love some feedback on the driving, weapons, destruction, and overall gameplay. It's still an early alpha, so your suggestions would mean a lot!

Thanks for checking it out! 🔥
